verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents a REST API for retrieving data, including the Get Decision endpoint for fetching the latest fraud decision per order, and webhooks that push decision updates in real time. Together these let a merchant pull or mirror some of its data in machine-readable form. However, nothing shows a bulk export of all account data or a documented path for leaving the platform. Missing for 10: bulk or full-account data export, documented open export formats, coverage of all data types (cases, chargebacks, policies, device data), an offboarding or data-portability policy, and independent corroboration.
